summary: Ente is an end-to-end encrypted platform designed for storing and sharing personal photographs as a self-hosted alternative to mainstream cloud services. It provides a secure repository for media libraries while maintaining privacy through client-side encryption. The codebase is distributed under the AGPL-3.0 licence.
goodFor: Privacy-conscious individuals who want to replace commercial cloud photo storage with an encrypted, self-hosted solution.
watchOut: Ente requires careful key management, as losing your encryption credentials means permanent loss of access to your stored photos.
deployNotes: Deployment typically relies on Docker for container orchestration, requiring persistent storage volumes for media data and a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
